title: Verifying Antibodies After Live Immunization Delivery (VALID): A Study of Measles Vaccine Immunogenicity in Children With Sickle Cell Disease
official: Verifying Antibodies After Live Immunization Delivery (VALID): a Study of Measles Vaccine Immunogenicity in Children With Sickle Cell Disease
summary: The goal of this study is to learn if infants with sickle cell disease (SCD) develop adequate protection after measles vaccines. (not looking at any prolonged duration)
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Participants with confirmed Sickle Cell Disease.
2. Participants 6 months and 6 years of age and due for measles vaccination within 3 months per national guidelines.
3. Willing and able to provide informed consent
4. Ability to comply with study related evaluations and follow-up visits.

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Known primary immunodeficiency syndrome, cancer, or acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) that would preclude vaccination with live virus vaccines.
